answer: Because the prism stake is held until the spiral settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the crystal audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 43% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. A farm running 118 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
